limits: The 413 packages passed deterministic qualification; independent review is ongoing and they are served at the community tier.
The consequence verdict covers 354 stored judged queries and the 448-grant Public Good policy, not every query or grant.
The customer check retrieves two packages; it does not test checkout, model-driven use, a missing body or rollback.
